# Third-party map assets

The website retains the map’s original pinned libraries and their attributions. Runtime assets and fonts are bundled in this directory; source URLs and local checksums are listed in sources.json.

- Leaflet 1.9.3: BSD 2-Clause; leaflet-LICENSE.txt.
- Leaflet.markercluster 1.1.0: MIT; markercluster-LICENSE.txt.
- jQuery 3.7.1: MIT; jquery-LICENSE.txt.
- D3 3.5.5: BSD 3-Clause; d3-LICENSE.txt.
- Bootstrap 5.2.2: MIT; bootstrap-LICENSE.txt.
- Leaflet.awesome-markers 2.0.2: MIT; awesome-markers-LICENSE.txt. Original project: https://github.com/lennardv2/Leaflet.awesome-markers .
- Bootstrap 3 glyphicons stylesheet/font: original Bootstrap 3 distribution. See bootstrap3-LICENSE.txt and https://getbootstrap.com/docs/3.3/components/ . Glyphicons Halflings are made available for Bootstrap by https://glyphicons.com/ .
- Font Awesome Free 6.2.0: fonts are under SIL OFL 1.1; CSS/code is MIT. Original notices in the bundled CSS; full license in fontawesome-LICENSE.txt.
- Folium awesome rotate stylesheet: original source URL retained in sources.json.

Basemap imagery is loaded live from OpenStreetMap. Its attribution remains visible in the map: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright . No tile archive is included.
